name: Febrile episode with tachycardia
title: Febrile episode with tachycardia
rationale: Core temperature is at or above 38 °C with a resting heart rate above 100 bpm. The combination warrants immediate review.
recommended_action: Stop activity. Contact the flight surgeon on the next comms window and begin the infection countermeasure checklist.

name: Blood pressure outside the safe range
title: Blood pressure outside the safe range
rationale: Systolic pressure is at or above 140 mmHg, or at or below 90 mmHg with symptoms. Either pattern needs review.
recommended_action: Rest, re-measure after five minutes, and contact the flight surgeon if the reading persists or symptoms worsen.

name: Blood glucose outside the safe range
title: Blood glucose outside the safe range
rationale: Blood glucose is below 70 mg/dL or above 250 mg/dL. Both extremes require immediate attention.
recommended_action: Follow the mission glucose protocol and contact the flight surgeon now.

name: Sleep debt is accumulating
title: Sleep debt is accumulating
rationale: Sleep has been under four hours for three consecutive nights. Recovery and cognitive performance are at risk.
recommended_action: Protect the next sleep window, reduce non-essential load, and log the change.

name: Mood and social withdrawal
title: Mood and social withdrawal
rationale: Mood has been at or below 2/5 for five consecutive days, with low crew contact. Isolation is a spaceflight hazard.
recommended_action: Schedule a private check-in, protect the sleep window, and offer a crew connection slot.

name: Orthostatic intolerance
title: Orthostatic intolerance
rationale: Heart rate rises by more than 30 bpm on standing. This can signal reduced orthostatic tolerance.
recommended_action: Review fluid and salt intake, repeat the test under the same conditions, and report dizziness or near-syncope.

name: Red-flag symptom reported
title: Red-flag symptom reported
rationale: Chest pain, dyspnea, vision loss, or fainting was reported. These findings should never wait for a trend.
recommended_action: Stop activity. Follow the emergency medical procedure and contact the flight surgeon immediately.
